The Rare Cut philosophy

At RARE CUT, we believe true luxury is found in rarity, authenticity, and timeless beauty.

Our collection celebrates exceptional natural gemstones and fine jewelry, carefully selected for their distinctive character, remarkable beauty, and enduring appeal. From extraordinary alexandrites and Paraíba tourmalines to exquisite sapphires, rubies, emeralds, and rare colored diamonds, every piece reflects our appreciation for nature's most exceptional treasures.

We believe that fine jewelry is more than an adornment. It is a personal expression of individuality, a celebration of life's meaningful moments, and a treasure to be cherished for generations.

The collections.

Three collections — rare gemstones, exceptional diamonds, and one-of-a-kind pieces chosen for the collector.

Pricing: pieces below $10,000 are shown with their price. Pieces priced at $10,000 and above are offered at Price Upon Inquiry — please contact the house for details.

The house atelier

Crafted to outlast.

Rare Cut follows a quieter tradition: exceptional material, measured settings, and hand-finished details made to endure beyond a single owner.

Character before uniformity: origin, shape, color, and proportion are considered as one composition.

Every line is judged by how the piece wears, catches light, and holds its silhouette.

A patient polish and close inspection complete the piece before it enters the collection.
